summary: Defines how to carry JPEG 2000 video, meaning a sequence of JPEG 2000 images, inside RTP packets. The payload format is designed to take advantage of JPEG 2000 features such as scalability. This is a Proposed Standard, extended by RFC 5372.

eli5.summary: A video is a flip book of pictures. This memo says how to cut each picture into pieces that fit into small mail packets, so they can be sent over the Internet and put back together.

questions: how to stream jpeg 2000 video over rtp
